title: So, you need a 21st century digital guru....
html:
So, you need a modern wiz-bang professional who will create cool online interactives? Oh wait, perhaps you need someone who can liaise with others and collect data through many channels? Or, someone who knows how to wrangle endless big data? Or someone who can protect your office from modern cybersecurity threats? Or maybe someone who can lead a team of such people? And, even if you can decide, how do you reconcile that against the 20th century, generic Job Description that your organization wants you to use for an Information Manager?

In the past, I have often found that hiring managers are either stuck with old-school, boilerplate,  job descriptions or they feel paralyzed not knowing how to define & prioritize the skills that they need to hire into their team/office. With this in mind, I was excited to have Esmée Tijsterman join me, under the supervision of Kenny Meesters, to look at defining a Competency Framework suited for a 21st century Humanitarian Information Manager.

Esmée spent a lot of time reading through recent job postings, speaking to hiring managers and evaluating different frameworks. The result is a great tool that can be used in multiple ways: 1) to help draft a job description, 2) to help prioritize the filtering of applicants, 3) to help a selected candidate better understand their work priorities, 4) to help conduct a self assessment and define development goals or select training programs, and 5) to help during an evaluation process. 

I went through the process myself and it forced me to really critique and prioritize what I needed. I was forced to make those hard decisions. Although it felt hard at the beginning, it resulted in things being clear upfront, a smoother-than-usual recruitment process, and a very positive result for those involved.

PDF

In the paper, we have also included two fictitious examples of how two positions can be scored on the framework. And, if you place the results on a graph, you quickly see where your priorities lay.

Hopefully you find this relatively simple framework as helpful as I have.

Andrej
teaser: A competency framework for the 21st century humanitarian Information Manager, developed by Esmée Tijsterman under Kenny Meesters' supervision.
seo_description: A modern competency framework for hiring Humanitarian Information Managers, based on job postings and hiring manager interviews, with two scored examples.
